The proposal should be rejected. No repository changes are appropriate.

- Configuration v1 is a frozen published contract; silently adding fields or changing semantics would violate its compatibility guarantee (`docs/decisions/0005-configuration-v1-compatibility.md:24`, `docs/decisions/0005-configuration-v1-compatibility.md:49`).
- Configuration v2 already provides universal `agents`/Claude/Gemini surfaces and continuity policy (`docs/decisions/0009-configuration-v2-and-universal-surfaces.md:20`).
- Existing v1 repositories remain supported and are never migrated implicitly.
- Users wanting universal support should explicitly run:
  ```text
  carrylog migrate --to 2 --universal --dry-run
  carrylog migrate --to 2 --universal
  carrylog validate
  ```
  Migration preserves comments and line endings, preflights outputs, and fails closed when customized checkpoint prose requires review (`docs/configuration.md:117`).
